plan: Given my value of $25, I aim to maximize profit by bidding slightly below my value to avoid overpaying. Expecting Betty and Charles to bid near their values, I will bid $24.9. This bid is high enough to potentially win if their values are slightly lower, while minimizing loss if I win. If they bid higher, I lose nothing. If they bid lower, I profit.

Given my value of $3, bidding higher than my value would lead to a loss if I win. To maximize profit, I should bid below or equal to my value, ideally slightly above what I expect others to bid low for a low-value item. Assuming others have random values, they might bid higher if their values exceed $3. I'll bid $2 to minimize loss if I win and hope others bid higher.

This strategy balances the risk of overbidding and ensures I don't pay more than my value.
